name: plan-atlas
description: Onboard a repository to plan-atlas: extract one plan document into checked plan data, suggest statuses from git and GitHub, and build the drill-down map.

interface.shortDescription: Check plans against git and GitHub
interface.longDescription: A linter for plans that AI agents maintain. The onboard skill extracts one plan document into plan data, runs check and status suggestions from git and GitHub, builds a drill-down map, and reports what needs your decision.
